task.title: Reduce automatic prose shapes in Conversation replies
task.source: User report and blind A/B review of live Conversation prompt snapshots

coreClaim: Conversation generation receives the tested lightweight prose-shape guide in its existing provider call while Roleplay retains its prior guide and Game remains unchanged.
rootCause: The previous prose-quality change deliberately applied only to Roleplay, so Conversation generation still had no bounded guidance against recurring contrast pivots, thesis restatements, and polished parallel structures.

inScope: Dry-run, preview, ordinary generation, regeneration, and direct fallback prompt handoff
Conversation, Roleplay, and Game routing regression coverage
outOfScope: Changing writer models or provider settings
Adding an agent, detector, retry, critic, or rewrite pass
Guaranteeing identical stochastic output for every character

claimBoundary.coreClaim: A Conversation request receives one compact mode-owned guide immediately before its final user message, without changing the existing Roleplay guide or Game prompts.
currentPathsOrFormats: The neutral insertion primitive places the selected system guide immediately before the final user message.
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not promise removal of every AI-shaped phrase.
This change does not alter model selection or generation parameters.
This change does not add a second generation call.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Conversation reply quality needed mode-specific prose guidance, but only the Roleplay path received a compact guide.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Conversation may own a bounded message-writing policy without sharing Roleplay narration policy or affecting Game generation.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The engine generation router selects a mode-owned guide, and the shared helper only inserts the selected system message before the final user turn.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: Chat owns Conversation writing policy; Roleplay owns Roleplay writing policy; engine generation owns explicit dispatch.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not restore a writing agent, add a post-generation rewrite, or move mode-specific guide strings into a generic shared helper.
regressionProof: Conversation routing test asserts its lighter message-shaped guide and final-user placement.
Roleplay routing test asserts its existing guide content and final-user placement.
Game routing test asserts the prompt remains unchanged.
The start-generation integration file and full repository gate pass.

positiveRows.claim: Conversation receives the lightweight prose-shape guide at the final prompt boundary.
positiveRows.evidence: prose-shape-guidance.spec.ts asserts the Conversation guide role, display name, message-shaped examples, exemption language, uniqueness, and insertion immediately before the final user message.

positiveRows.claim: The treatment improves the sampled live Conversation output without a model change.
positiveRows.evidence: Five blinded matched pairs used real Conversation prompt snapshots with the same model and settings; the treatment won 4, tied 1, and lost 0.
29 focused tests passed across generation-guide, mode routing, and start-generation integration.

positiveRows.claim: The repository shipping baseline remains green.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm check exited 0, including TypeScript, architecture, security, docs, workflow, frontend, and Rust workspace checks.

contradictionRows.claim: Game must not inherit Conversation or Roleplay prose policy.
contradictionRows.evidence: The Game negative-control test asserts the prompt is returned unchanged.

contradictionRows.claim: Roleplay must not inherit the new Conversation wording.
contradictionRows.evidence: The Roleplay route asserts the prior Roleplay display name and representative guide text; line-by-line comparison found no guide-line changes.
The Conversation guide explicitly keeps targeted shapes when they fit the character, user wording, or requested style.

untestedRows: No post-merge Pi generation has been run because the exact merged image does not exist yet.
The five-pair preference result is directional evidence, not a guarantee for every character or provider.

ownedFacts.description: The blind Conversation comparison preferred the treatment 4 times with 1 tie and no baseline wins.
ownedFacts.evidence: Five user-scored A/B pairs generated from live prompt snapshots with treatment identity hidden until scoring completed.

ownedFacts.description: Conversation and Roleplay prompt strings are owned by separate mode modules.
ownedFacts.evidence: Current diff places the strings under src/engine/modes/chat/core and src/engine/modes/roleplay/core; the generation router imports both explicit owners.

ownedFacts.description: Game prompts do not receive either guide.
ownedFacts.evidence: The focused Game negative-control test passes and asserts exact prompt equality.

manualBlockers.reason: The deterministic routing contract and live A/B treatment behavior are already proven; deployment verification can only occur after merge.

verification.baselineEvidence: The Conversation test first failed because no guide was inserted; after implementation, 29 focused tests and the full pnpm check passed.
